question: What portion of the one-hundred-twenty-one-pada diagram does Brahma occupy?
premises: The diagram consists of one hundred twenty-one padas.
Brahma occupies part of this diagram.
His occupation is in the middle.
inference: Brahma occupies the middle portion of the one-hundred-twenty-one-pada diagram.
uncertainties: The exact number of central padas occupied is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: In the one-hundred-twenty-one-pada diagram, Brahma occupies the middle.
